title: Secretly

inlines.v: SE'CRETLY, adv. 1. Privately; privily; not openly; without the knowledge of others; as, to dispatch a messenger secretly. 2. Inwardly; not apparently or visibly; latently. Now secretly with inward grief she pin'd. Addison.
